# viettelcloud_vpc_peering (Data Source)

Get a Viettel Cloud VPC peering by ID, name, requester and accepter VPC, or status. Without `id`, `name`, or `status`, only `pending` and `active` peerings match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a VPC peering by ID
data "viettelcloud_vpc_peering" "by_id" {
  id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}

# Look up the pending or active peering from one VPC to another
data "viettelcloud_vpc_peering" "by_vpcs" {
  requester_vpc_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  accepter_vpc_id  = "yyyyyyyy-yyyy-yyyy-yyyy-yyyyyyyyyyyy"
}

# Look up a VPC peering by name, in any status
data "viettelcloud_vpc_peering" "by_name" {
  name = "peer-xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `accepter_vpc_id` (String) ID (UUID) of the accepter VPC to filter by.
- `id` (String) VPC peering ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Exact name of the peering to filter by.
- `requester_vpc_id` (String) ID (UUID) of the requester VPC to filter by.
- `status` (String) Peering status to filter by: `pending`, `active`, `rejected`, or `error`.

### Read-Only

- `accepter_project_id` (String) ID (UUID) of the project that owns the accepter VPC.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the peering was created (RFC3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the peering.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the peering was last updated (RFC3339).
- `vpc_peering_type` (String) `intra_region` when both VPCs are in one region, otherwise `inter_region`.
